summary: Verified new Council Models edit/delete feature. Added 6 new backend tests (test_council_models_edit.py) covering PUT /api/config -> app_settings mirror for both council_models and chairman_model, plus GET /api/admin/models reflection and delete persistence. All 28 backend tests pass (6 new + 22 regression). Frontend UI verified end-to-end: per-model edit (data-testid=edit-model-btn-<id>) opens inline editor (edit-model-input + confirm/cancel), Save Council persists across reload; delete (remove-model-btn-<id>) removes from 'Your Council' and persists after reload (verified via UI + backend). Original council_models state restored after tests.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/config correctly mirrors council_models + chairman_model into settings_store, so config_manager.get_council_models/get_chairman_model (which read app_settings first) see the update immediately -- live council pipeline uses edited ids without redeploy.
Frontend Settings.jsx edit flow correctly reassigns chairmanModel when the edited id was previously the chairman (line 125) -- no orphan chairman after rename.
Note: the frontend Save Council path allows saving 1 model, but the admin DELETE endpoint enforces >=2. This is documented; not a bug for the Settings flow which uses PUT /api/config.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. app_settings.council_models restored to original [openai/gpt-4o, google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp, anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet, x-ai/grok-2] and chairman_model=google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp after test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verified. Backend: PUT /api/config with {council_models, chairman_model} mirrors to app_settings; GET /api/admin/models is the live source of truth (reads app_settings). Frontend testids: edit-model-btn-<id>, remove-model-btn-<id>, edit-model-input, confirm-edit-<id>, cancel-edit-<id>, btn-save-models. UI test caveat: model ids appear both in left picker (available models) and right council list -- to check deletion, count only in council list scope (locator '.council-list') not page-wide.
